guidance: JSW Cement Limited October 28, 2026 Page 3 of 16 We remain constructive on the demand outlook for the balance of the year, particularly as infrastructure execution and construction activity gather pace.
With the momentum that exists, we expect to meet what we had committed in quarter 1, which is high-single digits and hoping to improve that.
capex: The additional 1 million ton per annum grinding capacity commissioned in October further strengthens our ability to serve this r egion, and our costs will continue to reduce over the coming quarters.
As committed, during quarter 2, we commissioned the waste heat recovery system and the alternate fuel rehandling co -processing system in the Nagaur Integrated Unit.
risks: Quarter 2 FY27 has seen a challenging external environment, marked by geopolitical uncertainties arising from the ongoing West Asia crisis and weaker monsoon, which has impacted the broader operating environment.
As all of you are aware, pet coke prices are at very high levels, and this will create more cost pressure in the coming quarter.
focus: We are also continuing our dealer network expansion, while focusing on product quality, service levels and cost reduction initiatives.
And with the kind of cost pressures that the industry is facing, we believe the price table that we and that the industry is targeting will hold on.
We are targeting close to 60% by end of the year.
